articles.title: Wall Street climbs as falling oil prices, bond yields lift market sentiment
articles.excerpt:
Major US stock indexes moved higher on Thursday as a pullback in crude oil prices and lower Treasury yields improved investor sentiment following the Federal Reserve's latest interest-rate decision.

At 09:38 a.m. ET, the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 316.08 points, or 0.59%, to 51,763.46, the S&P 500 added 71.28 points, or 0.94%, to 7,623.09, and the Nasdaq Composite gained 321.49 points, or 1.25%, to 26,302.28.

articles.title: India’s municipal bond market gets SEBI push as urban funding needs rise
articles.excerpt:
SEBI plans to encourage municipalities to pool financing needs and issue bonds collectively to help fund India’s urban infrastructure requirements. | Photo Credit: iStockphoto

India’s capital markets regulator will encourage municipalities to pool their financing needs and issue bonds collectively to fund the upgrade of urban infrastructure that may cost up to $900 billion through 2031.

The Securities and Exchange Board of India in May issued a consultation paper that aims to bridge urban funding gaps by lowering entry barriers for smaller towns via pooled funding vehicles.

New India Assurance holds a 1.42% direct stake in NSE, according to the exchange’s Red Herring Prospectus, making it a direct beneficiary of any value unlocked through the listing. Stock Holding Corporation of India (SHCIL) holds a 4.4% stake in NSE, while IFCI is a promoter of SHCIL.

articles.excerpt:
